title: Ischemia- Modified Albumin Levels in the Sudden Hearing Loss
brief_summary: To evaluate ischemia-modified albumin levels in these patients to investigate the presence of ischemia in patients presenting with sudden hearing loss.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Admission with sensorineural hearing loss

Exclusion Criteria:

* cardiovascular disease
* hypertension
* diabetes mellitus
* malignancy
* chronic inflammatory disease
* kidney failure
* liver failure
study_population: The study group will include the patients with SSHL and control group will include the healthy controls with normal hearing thresholds
